name: Voxel Backface Culling and Internal Face Masking
definition: A technique to reject invisible faces in voxel rendering by determining front/back orientation in projection space and masking faces shared between neighboring voxels.
summary: Voxel Backface Culling and Internal Face Masking optimizes voxel mesh generation by rejecting invisible faces during geometry generation, distinguishing itself by handling front/back orientation to avoid rendering internal surfaces.
